sources.summary: The Plinth House 2 is the final in a triptych of projects in the bucolic setting of Langdons Hill , just south of Daylesford. The first, completed in 2014, was a compact, yet considered, renovation of the main house that delivered an award-winning view. Three years later came the Guest Pod; a combined studio and sleeping space for friends and family to work or relax on the property.
